map.计算达到目标批次所需的累积步数。: Compute the accumulation steps needed to reach a target batch.
map.显存不够放大 batch 时，用小批量连续跑若干步再把梯度相加、只做一次参数更新: When memory cannot fit a larger batch, run several small batches consecutively, sum their gradients, and update parameters only once, equivalent to large-batch training. Note that normalization-layer statistics and BatchNorm still compute per small batch, not fully equivalent to a true large batch; scale the learning rate by the effective batch.
map.累积步数越多显存占用越低。: More accumulation steps means lower memory usage.
map.等效 batch=单卡 batch×累积步数×GPU 数；累积步数=目标 bat: Effective batch = per-card batch x accumulation steps x GPU count; accumulation steps = target batch / per-card batch.
map.显存不足时用小 batch 累积多次再更新，模拟大 batch 的统计效果。: When memory is insufficient, accumulate several small batches before updating, simulating the statistical effect of a large batch.
map.累积期间不更新参数、只累加梯度，故优化步数变少、训练更慢但等效 batch 更大: During accumulation parameters are not updated, only gradients summed, so optimization steps are fewer, training slower, but the effective batch is larger.
map.目标 batch=128、单卡 batch=32、2 卡 → 累积步数=128/: Target batch=128, per-card batch=32, 2 cards -> accumulation steps = 128/(32x2)=2. Every 2 small steps sum gradients then update once; effective batch=128.
map.等效 batch 相同则统计近似一致，但累积使更新频率降低、训练更慢；学习率应按: With the same effective batch the statistics are approximately consistent, but accumulation lowers update frequency and slows training; tune the learning rate by effective batch, not per-card batch.
map.累积步数设太大怎样？: What if accumulation steps are set too large?
map.等效 batch 过大易泛化变差、显存虽省但训练极慢；且 BN 统计仍按小 ba: An overly large effective batch easily hurts generalization; memory is saved but training is extremely slow; and BN statistics still follow the small batch, deviating from a true large batch, so increase BN momentum or use synchronized BN.
map.梯度累积步数（本页代码口径）：累积步数=⌈目标批量÷(单卡批量×GPU数)⌉（向: Gradient accumulation steps (this page's code): accumulation steps=⌈target batch÷(per-GPU batch×GPU count)⌉ (rounded up to an integer); actual effective batch=per-GPU batch×GPU count×accumulation steps. Validation: no strict checks; empty values count as 0; a zero denominator or empty input making the result non-finite adds the "Some results are undefined" warning. Grading: no fixed tiers; steps fall as the per-GPU batch or GPU count rises, and rounding up guarantees the effective batch is at least the target.
map.判读与示例（本页代码口径，与上方公式互补）：目标 128、单卡 32、2 卡 →: Interpretation and example (this page's code, complementary to the formula above): target 128, per-GPU 32, 2 GPUs → 64 samples per step, ⌈128÷64⌉=2 steps of accumulation then one update, effective batch 128, half the accumulation steps of a single GPU. Validation shares the same inputs (any of target batch, per-GPU batch or GPU count being 0 triggers the undefined warning). Grading: no fixed tiers; note that gradient accumulation does not change how normalization layers compute statistics per mini-batch, so the learning rate should scale with the effective batch.
